grupales.title: Magical Torres del Paine
grupales.shortDescription: Enjoy an unforgettable experience in the heart of Chilean Patagonia. A trip designed to connect with wild nature.
grupales.description:
Enjoy an unforgettable experience in the heart of Chilean Patagonia. A trip designed to connect with wild nature, hike imposing trails, and contemplate landscapes unique in the world.

Minimum group: 6 passengers.

🗺️ Day-by-Day Itinerary:

• Day 1: Welcome to Patagonia and First Views
Meeting: Group reception at the Puerto Natales Airport.
Route to the park: Direct transfer to Hostería Pehoé, located in the heart of Torres del Paine.
Daily Activities: Visit to the Cueva del Milodón Natural Monument (subject to opening hours) and Trekking along the Condor Trail, a perfect natural viewpoint for panoramic postcards of the Paine Massif.

• Day 2: Photographic Safari and Paine Viewpoints
Vehicle exploration: Panoramic tour designed to capture the park's contrasts.
Key points to visit: Grey Beach (views of icebergs), Villa Monzino, Sarmiento Gate, Amarga Lagoon, the impressive Paine Waterfall, and Azul Lagoon.

• Day 3: The Great Challenge (Route to Choose)
Main Option - Base Torres Trail (High Difficulty): Patagonia's most famous hike. Demanding but rewarding, crowning at the turquoise lagoon at the foot of the imposing monolithic towers.
Alternative Option - French Valley Trail (Medium/High Difficulty): Hike towards the granite wall amphitheater in the heart of the W circuit. (Note: This option requires the extra catamaran payment at Pehoé Lake).

• Day 4: Wildlife Tracking and Return
Morning adventure: Hike along the Aonikenk Trail, an area of Patagonian steppe ideal for spotting local wildlife such as guanacos, foxes, and, with luck, the elusive puma.
Farewell: Return by private transport to the city of Puerto Natales to conclude the services.
includes: Transfers: Private round-trip transportation from Puerto Natales to the hotel inside the park.
Route Leader: Certified driver-guide throughout the journey.
Accommodation: Stay at the iconic Hostería Pehoé with breakfast included.
Adventures: Daily guided excursions according to the itinerary.
Trail rations: Daily snacks for the hikes.
Security: Travel assistance insurance included.
excludes: Entrance fees to Torres del Paine National Park and Cueva del Milodón Monument.
Pehoé Lake catamaran tickets (needed for French Valley option).

valdivia.title: Private 4x4 Tour: Oncol Park & Pilolcura
valdivia.shortDescription: 4x4 expedition exploring the Valdivian Rainforest ending at the Pacific Ocean.
valdivia.description:
An expedition designed for those seeking to disconnect from the world and connect with the purest biodiversity of Southern Chile. Aboard an off-road vehicle, we will cross the Coastal Mountain Range to explore the secrets of the ancient Valdivian Rainforest and end the day facing the untamed beaches of the Pacific Ocean.

Maximum Group: 4 to 6 passengers (Exclusive 4x4 Vehicle)

🗺️ Experience Itinerary:

• 08:30 hrs - Departure from Valdivia: We start the journey crossing towards Isla Teja, quickly entering the dense coastal vegetation through scenic roads.
• 09:30 hrs - Hiking & Interpretation in Oncol Park: Guided walk at a relaxed pace. We will learn to identify sacred trees and tune our ears to register the songs of the elusive Chucao and Magellanic Woodpecker.
• 13:30 hrs - 4x4 Descent to the Coast & Premium Picnic: Arrival at the wild Pilolcura beach. We will set up an exclusive box-lunch or picnic by the sea and observe seabird colonies with binoculars.
• 16:00 hrs - Scenic Return: Return trip driving along the coast.
• 17:00 hrs - Arrival in Valdivia.
includes: Private Transport: 4x4 off-road vehicle.
Specialized Guide: Expert professional certified in WFR.
Access Tickets: Free entry to Oncol Park.
Equipment: Loan of trekking poles and professional binoculars.
Gastronomic Experience: Premium picnic facing the sea in Pilolcura.
excludes: Personal Equipment: Warm clothing, trekking shoes, waterproof jackets.

valdivia.title: Private 4x4 Tour: Giants of Alerce Costero
valdivia.shortDescription: Exclusive 4x4 journey to one of the oldest living beings on the planet.
valdivia.description:
An exclusive journey to one of the oldest living beings on the planet: the Great Grandfather Millenary Alerce. We will cross the imposing Coastal Mountain Range aboard an off-road transport to explore a unique Jurassic ecosystem, enjoying top-level service.

Exclusive Capacity: 1 to 4 passengers

🗺️ Experience Itinerary:

• 08:30 hrs - Departure from Valdivia heading towards La Unión.
• 09:45 hrs - 4x4 Mountain Ascent: The paved road gives way to a gravel route with steep slopes.
• 10:30 hrs - Guided Trek to the Great Grandfather: Hike along the Millenary Alerce Trail (2.4 km). We will walk surrounded by Coihues and Tepas until we reach the majestic Great Grandfather, over 4 meters in diameter.
• Premium Picnic Lunch: In the mountains, surrounded by alerces, we will set up an exclusive signature picnic with gourmet options.
• 17:00 hrs - Arrival in Valdivia: End of the excursion.
includes: Private Transport: 4x4 off-road vehicle adapted for mountain routes.
Specialized Guide: Professional certified in WFR.
Access Tickets: Managed entries for the Viewpoint Sector.
Equipment: Loan of trekking poles and professional binoculars.
Gastronomic Experience: Premium signature picnic with local ingredients.
excludes: Personal Equipment: Mandatory technical footwear, layered clothing.

valdivia.title: Private 4x4 Tour: Pico de Toribio Trekking
valdivia.shortDescription: High mountain expedition in Futrono with panoramic views of Lake Ranco.
valdivia.description:
A high mountain expedition designed for true lovers of trekking and adventure. We will travel to Futrono to ascend the majestic Pico de Toribio. We will navigate the initial rural roads in a 4x4 and then begin a vertical ascent that will reward us with an infinite view of lakes and volcanoes.

Difficulty: High (Demanding)

🗺️ Experience Itinerary:

• 07:00 hrs - Early Departure from Valdivia: Heading to Futrono to optimize daylight.
• 4x4 Approach: Entering through complex trails to reduce initial wear.
• Trekking and Vertical Ascent: 4.5 km uphill with a steep incline. We will pass by a beautiful hidden mountain lagoon.
• Summit Conquest (1,311 masl): Arrival at the rocky viewpoint to contemplate Lake Ranco and the Caulle volcanoes.
• Premium Picnic Lunch: High-calorie gourmet options designed for energy recovery at the summit.
• Technical Descent and Return: Careful return to the base and trip to Valdivia at 17:00 hrs.
includes: Private Transport: 4x4 off-road vehicle.
Specialized Guide: Mountain guide certified in WFR.
Access Tickets: Managed registrations with local administrators.
Equipment: Loan of adjustable trekking poles (critical for the incline) and binoculars.
Gastronomic Experience: Premium signature picnic at the summit.
excludes: Personal Equipment: Mandatory high-top technical footwear, hiking backpacks (20-30L).

valdivia.title: Eco-Kayak & Birdwatching Cutipay River
valdivia.duration: Half Day (approx. 2 hrs in the water)
valdivia.shortDescription: Kayak experience through the calm waters of the Cutipay River connecting with birdlife.
valdivia.description:
A contemplative and low environmental impact tourism experience designed to connect with the birdlife of the Valdivian wetlands. We will glide in kayaks through the calm waters of the Cutipay River, offering a perfect setting for photography and observing birds hidden in the reeds.

Difficulty: Low (Suitable for beginners)

🗺️ Experience Itinerary:

• Early Departure from Valdivia: Towards the coastal sector during peak bird activity.
• Safety Briefing: Technical induction on kayak use and safety protocols.
• Navigation and Observation (1.5 hrs): We will enter calm river branches. We will look for the Many-colored Rush Tyrant, herons, Night Herons, Black-necked Swans, and the Kingfisher. The silence of the kayak will allow us to approach at ideal distances.
• End of Navigation & Premium Snack: Box-lunch by the river with bean coffee and local pastries.
• Return to Valdivia.
includes: Private Transport: Round trip from accommodation.
Specialized Guide: Professional certified in WFR and water rescue.
Nautical Equipment: Kayaks, paddles, and certified life jackets.
Equipment: Sealed and waterproof professional binoculars.
Gastronomic Experience: Premium snack with local products.
excludes: Personal Equipment: Mandatory change of clothes, footwear suitable for getting wet (sandals or aquashoes).
